why_no_live_adapter: Accepted packet D still labels the credential procedure missing; ARM requalification and transport are under exact review. Neither hash-shaped evidence nor a caller boolean authenticates authority. This patch does not invent those prerequisites. It is not a complete runnable C2 controller.
ports_are_trusted_code: No plugin loader, module-name option, environment discovery or dynamic adapter loading. Synthetic FakePorts is test-only. A future exact implementation must bind and authenticate concrete ports; passing tests with fakes does not qualify them.
admission_binding: The trusted admission port must use the exact reviewed admission implementation and its real PreviewAdmission. It must match all credential bindings to the packet and exact reviewed evidence; the core additionally checks the binding hash and fixed same-process deadline. This is an explicit integration obligation, not implemented authentication.
build_contract: Compile model Main source only, inside the exact native linux/arm64 JDK container using javac --release 21 and trusted jar packaging. No model build plugins/downloads. No implicit pull/emulation. Enforce phase deadline and complete reap; return minimal typed source/JAR/runtime/config/tool hashes. Compiler diagnostics never enter model context.
gate_contract: Verifier-only adapter binds exact ARM gate, case manifest and candidate artifact, enforces phase original deadline and cleanup, and returns only ten verdict enums and joins. Hidden data/reports never cross into request construction. Gate errors become stop, never model diagnostics.
request_proof_contract: Proof port must construct the reviewed transport ReviewedRequest for the exact projection digest, prove its token bound before any count send, and bind the reviewed proof algorithm and public-context approval. No unproved byte-to-token estimate or count-as-pre-count-proof substitution.
